source_caption:
Kendall Roy is one of Succession’s most tragic characters because he keeps mistaking pain for depth and ambition for purpose. Jeremy Strong plays him like someone constantly trying to become the man his father wanted, while quietly falling apart under the weight of knowing he may never be enough.

Succession (2018–2023), created by Jesse Armstrong, starring Jeremy Strong, Brian Cox, Kieran Culkin. A sharp and addictive drama about power, inheritance, and emotional damage, following a media dynasty whose greatest battles happen inside the family.

source_details.synopsis: Succession is an American satirical comedy-drama television series created by English screenwriter Jesse Armstrong that aired for four seasons on HBO from June 3, 2018, to May 28, 2023. The series centers on the Roy family, the owners of global media and entertainment conglomerate Waystar RoyCo, and their fight for control of the company amidst uncertainty about the health of the family's patriarch. Brian Cox portrays the family patriarch Logan Roy. His children are played by Alan Ruck as Connor, Jeremy Strong as Kendall, Kieran Culkin as Roman, and Sarah Snook as Shiv.
